knowledge:
- key_parameters: n_genes=The total number of genes to simulate ;; proportion=The proportion of genes that will have no spatially varying patterns (i.e., random noise) ;; coords=A matrix of spatial coordinates (e.g., containing columns for x and y coordinates) ;; range_sigma.sq=A numeric vector of length 2 specifying the range of the spatial variance parameter (sigma^2) ;; range_beta=A numeric vector of length 2 specifying the range of the mean expression value (beta) ;; length_scale=A numeric vector specifying the length scale parameter(s) (l) which determine how quickly spatial correlation decays with distance ;; length_scale_option=A character string, either "fixed" or "unique", specifying whether to use a single fixed length scale or a unique length scale for each gene
- alternatives: None mentioned for simulation; the simulated data is intended to benchmark downstream SVG detection methods available in Bioconductor
- when_to_use: Use this package when you need to generate in silico spatial transcriptomics data with realistic spatial variation and mean-variance relationships to evaluate or develop spatial analysis methods
- pitfalls: Simulating data with a unique length scale per gene (length_scale_option = "unique") is computationally slower than using a fixed length scale because the Gaussian Process covariance matrix must be recalculated for every individual gene

workflows.name: simulate_spatial_transcriptomics
workflows.intent: Simulate spatial transcriptomics count data with spatial variation using a Gaussian Process model based on user-provided spatial coordinates.
input: coords.csv (A matrix or data frame of spatial coordinates with columns representing spatial dimensions, such as pixel columns and rows)
workflows.stages: 1. Define or load spatial coordinates matrix ;; 2. Set simulation parameters including gene count, noise proportion, variance range, mean range, and length scale ;; 3. Run the simulation using spatial_simulate with either fixed or unique length scale options to generate a SpatialExperiment object
workflows.code:
# 20 spots per side
n_side <- 20

# x and y coordinates for the grid
x_coords <- rep(1:n_side, each = n_side)
y_coords <- rep(1:n_side, times = n_side)

# combine into a matrix
coords <- cbind(x_coords, y_coords)
colnames(coords) <- c("pxl_col_in_fullres", "pxl_row_in_fullres")

n_genes <- 5
proportion <- 0.4
range_sigma.sq <- c(1.5, 3)
range_beta <- c(3, 7)

length_scale <- 60

set.seed(16)
spe <- spatial_simulate(n_genes, proportion, coords,
                        range_sigma.sq, range_beta,
                        length_scale, length_scale_option = "fixed")

length_scale <- c(60, 40, 20, 80, 100)

set.seed(1)
spe <- spatial_simulate(n_genes, proportion, coords,
                        range_sigma.sq, range_beta,
                        length_scale, length_scale_option = "unique")
